# Project Room Preparation

Organize messy project sources into an inspectable "project room" before
drafting begins.

## Overview

Use this skill when you are about to draft a high-stakes deliverable (board
memo, strategy doc, investor update, proposal, article, brief) from a messy or
unorganized set of project sources — or when you ask to "organize my project
files", "build a source inventory", "prepare these sources", "audit these
uploads", or "refresh the project room".

It produces a source inventory, a duplicate log, a conflict log, a
missing-context list, and a working brief, then drafts only from the clean room.
The workflow is four orchestrated prompts: room builder (file-system tools),
source inventory & audit (upload-based tools), grounded draft from the clean
room, and project room refresh.
